LAPACK and LAPACKE
BSD 3-Clause License (LAPACK); BSD 3-Clause, Intel variant (LAPACKE)

Statically linked into the engine library that this mod carries. The engine's sparse
Cholesky and LDL^T factorisations call LAPACK through the LAPACKE C interface. Not used
by the sidecar executable of the earlier shipping shape.

Source: http://www.netlib.org/lapack/
